content: In this section, we use the proposed method to quickly adapt an existing general-domain QA model to an emerging target domain: Covid-19. Our baseline model is SQuADBERT (bert-large-uncased-whole-word-masking-finetuned-squad), a version of BERT that was finetuned on general-domain SQuAD BIBREF19. We evaluate on Deepset-AI Covid-QA, a SQuAD-style dataset with 1380 questions (see Appendix for details on data and preprocessing). We assume that there is no target-domain finetuning data, which is a realistic setup for a new domain.
